profile.name: Aaron Aludo
profile.availability: Building practical AI-powered tools and continuing to learn through real projects.

about.title: About
paragraphs: I’m a full-stack software engineer who enjoys building end-to-end applications with JavaScript, Python, and PHP. I like working across frontend and backend systems, and I try to keep my work practical, reliable, and easy to improve over time.

Recently, I have been exploring AI by building small, useful applications and learning from each project. I’m interested in how AI can help solve real problems in simple ways, and I’m continuing to improve how I design, build, and maintain systems that are helpful to users.
